title: The workstation: CodeEditor.tsx
body: Pasted four times, grown once — deduplicated. 16 quick-insert symbols, synced line numbers, cursor tracking, Tab handling, touch-aware focus. Committed verbatim at CodeEditor.tsx and opened live in the site editor. This block grew from a planted seed, not the built-in dozen.
